scope: External Windows distribution files, ZIP namespace, checksum and source licenses. ASAR and its unpacked payload require the separate internal audit.
sourceProvenance: Source commit and expected ZIP checksum supplied from CI; license content read from this exact Git object.

method.chunks: 1 MiB with 8 KiB overlap; required-marker candidates decoded in bounded context windows.

limitations: Only this stated scope is evaluated; combine with the separate ASAR/unpacked audit of the same ZIP hash.
A pattern match is a review finding, not automatically a live credential.
Pattern scanning does not prove absence of arbitrary encoded secrets.

review.classification: The one generic Unix-home reference is byte-for-byte identical to a reference in the installed locked Electron executable. It is not a developer path introduced by the project.

finalDisposition: External scope PASS after classifying the single upstream reference. The original automated false flags are retained; full-package acceptance also requires the separate application audit of the same ZIP.
